description: Get the current status and next action of a formation.

formation_id.description: Formation ID to query (op_fm_* format). Returned by offshoreproz_create_formation or offshoreproz_list_formations.

name: offshoreproz_get_formation_status

action_url.description: URL for the next action step, if applicable

next_action.description: Human-readable description of the next required action, if any

status.description: Current status (e.g. pending_owner_confirmation, kyc_pending, filed, complete, failed)
